function: Channel estimation in OTFS-ISAC: an FNN classifier estimates the number of paths (model order) for a correlation-based delay-Doppler estimator, reused for radar sensing (p. 8).
system: Single-antenna Tx and communication Rx plus co-located sensing Rx; no RIS; fc = 5 GHz, 15 kHz subcarrier spacing, M=64, N=16 OTFS grid (pp. 4, 12).
method: Two-hidden-layer fully connected FNN (ReLU, softmax), supervised multi-class classification with cross-entropy; rest of the receiver is non-learned (pp. 8-9, 13).
data_channel: Custom simulator: 4 Rayleigh paths, PDP [0, 2.4, 5, 7] us, Jakes Doppler at 500 km/h. Training: 3x6000 pilot frames with P~U[2,5] paths, uniform PDP (pp. 12-13).
test_conditions: Train: Rayleigh, SNRp 5/10/15 dB, uniform PDP, random delays. Test: continuous SNR, non-uniform PDP, off-grid delays, Rician K sweep, unseen P=6 (pp. 13, 15-16).
baselines: Non-learned only: threshold method, SC-based TSE and PIPIC, LMMSE equalizer, CRLB; Landweber in complexity table; no earlier learned estimator compared (pp. 12-17).
metrics: Channel NMSE, average number of detected paths, range and velocity RMSE versus CRLB, BER versus Eb/N0, average IMFC iterations (pp. 13-18).
complexity: Orders in Tables 1-2: FNN model-order selection O((MN)^2); disjoint refinement O(LhNk)+O(LhNl); IMFC O(nPM^2N) versus LMMSE O((MN)^3) (pp. 10, 12).
q1_support: p. 12: "A channel with P = 4 Rayleigh faded paths is considered." Custom Rayleigh/Jakes simulator with its own PDP; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used anywhere.
q2_support: p. 16: "Since the FNN is trained exclusively under Rayleigh fading statistics" it is tested under Rician fading with a LoS component (K from -10 to 30 dB).
q3_support: p. 14: "compared with the SC-based approach (specifically, the TSE method" and PIPIC; threshold, SC-based, TSE, PIPIC and LMMSE are all non-learned, and the learned OTFS estimators cited on p. 2 are never compared.
q4_support: p. 12: "complexity of the proposed IMFC reduces to O(nPM 2 N)"; Table 1 (p. 10) also lists O((MN)^2) for the FNN-based estimation of P.
q5_support: p. 12: "A channel with P = 4 Rayleigh faded paths is considered." The data are generated by the authors' simulator; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset.
notes: Included: the only learned part is the FNN that estimates the number of paths P, which the paper counts as part of channel estimation (p. 6: goal is to determine (P, g_i, tau_i, nu_i)); p. 8 states the DL-aided scheme is proposed to estimate P. The correlation estimator and the IMFC detector are non-learned. Area 4 (delay-Doppler channel estimation and detection) rather than 5, since no beams, waveforms or resources are designed; single-antenna links are admitted for OTFS. The PDP of p. 12 is custom and not attributed to any standard. q2 also rests on a non-uniform PDP with off-grid delays at test time (p. 13) and on an unseen P=6 (p. 15).
